Recipes Fixation solution Add 10 mL of 32% PFA solution stock in 150 mL of PBS pH 7.4 to make 2% PFA and mix well. Store leftover diluted PFA in air-tight bottles, protected from light at either RT (for up to one week) or 4 °C for up to one month. Permeabilization solution Add 12.5 mL of 10% Triton X-100 solution in 487.5 mL of PBS (pH 7.4) to make 0.25% Triton X-100 solution. Mix well and store at RT. Wash buffer A Dissolve 8.8 g of NaCl, 1.2 g of Tris base, and 0.5 mL of Tween 20 in 800 mL of autoclaved water. Adjust pH to 7.4 using HCl. Add autoclaved water to 1,000 mL (final concentrations 0.01 M Tris, 0.15 M NaCl, and 0.05% Tween 20). Filter the solution (0.22 μm filter) and store at 4 °C. Bring the solutions to RT before use. Wash buffer B Dissolve 5.84 g of NaCl, 4.24 g of Tris base, and 26 g of Tris-HCl in 500 mL of autoclaved water. Adjust pH to 7.5 using HCl. Add autoclaved water to 1,000 mL (final concentrations 0.2 M Tris and 0.1 M NaCl). Filter the solution (0.22 μm filter) and store at 4 °C. Bring the solutions to RT before use. EdU stock solution Add 2 mL of DMSO directly into the vial containing 50 mg of EdU to make 100 mM stocks. Dissolve powder by vortexing. Store aliquots of stock solution at -20 °C protected from light. Biotin-azide stock solution Add 1.623 mL of DMSO directly into the vial containing 1 mg of biotin azide to make 1 mM stocks. Dissolve powder by vortexing. Store aliquots of stock solution at -20 °C, desiccate, and protect from light. Alexa488-azide stock solution Add 0.58 mL of DMSO directly into the vial containing 0.5 mg of Alexa 488 azide to make 1 mM stocks. Dissolve powder by vortexing. Store aliquots of stock solution at -20 °C, desiccate, and protect from light.

steps.title: Prepare solutions and reagents
steps.instruction: Make all required solutions fresh: 2 % PFA fixation solution (add 10 mL 32 % PFA to 150 mL PBS, store airtight, protected from light at RT ≤1 week or 4 °C ≤1 month); 0.25 % Triton X‑100 permeabilization solution (add 12.5 mL 10 % Triton X‑100 to 487.5 mL PBS, store at RT); Wash buffer A (dissolve 8.8 g NaCl, 1.2 g Tris base, 0.5 mL Tween 20 in 800 mL autoclaved water, adjust pH 7.4 with HCl, bring to 1 L; final 0.01 M Tris, 0.15 M NaCl, 0.05 % Tween 20, filter 0.22 µm, store 4 °C); Wash buffer B (dissolve 5.84 g NaCl, 4.24 g Tris base, 26 g Tris‑HCl in 500 mL autoclaved water, adjust pH 7.5 with HCl, bring to 1 L; final 0.2 M Tris, 0.1 M NaCl, filter 0.22 µm, store 4 °C); EdU stock (add 2 mL DMSO to 50 mg EdU, vortex, 100 mM, aliquot, store –20 °C protected from light); Biotin‑azide stock (add 1.623 mL DMSO to 1 mg biotin‑azide, vortex, 1 mM, aliquot, store –20 °C desiccated, protected from light); Alexa‑488‑azide stock (add 0.58 mL DMSO to 0.5 mg Alexa‑488‑azide, vortex, 1 mM, aliquot, store –20 °C desiccated, protected from light).

steps.title: Seed cells and EdU labeling
steps.instruction: One day before the assay, plate 1 × 10⁴–2 × 10⁴ log‑phase adherent cells in 300 µL appropriate growth medium per well of an 8‑well chamber slide; let cells reach 50 %–60 % confluence on the day of the experiment. Pre‑warm growth medium to 37 °C, aspirate medium, add 200 µL pre‑warmed medium containing 20 µM EdU, and incubate 1 h at 37 °C in a tissue‑culture incubator.

steps.title: Optional replication stalling treatment
steps.instruction: After the 1 h EdU pulse, aspirate EdU medium, gently wash wells once with RT PBS, then add growth medium containing a mtDNA replication stalling agent (ddC 20 µM, MitoPQ 10 µM, or mtOX 4 µM) for 1–3 h at 37 °C before fixation. For replication‑restart assays, perform the stalling treatment, wash quickly with PBS, and add fresh EdU‑containing medium again. Include a well with no EdU as a negative control.

steps.title: Fix cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Aspirate medium and wash wells twice with RT PBS. Add 200 µL freshly prepared 2 % PFA (in PBS) to each well, incubate 15 min at RT without disturbing the slide. Discard PFA, wash wells twice with PBS for 5 min each at RT. Disassemble chambers, remove silicone gaskets with fine curved forceps, and keep wells submerged in PBS (e.g., in a Coplin jar) to prevent drying. Fixed slides may be stored in PBS at 4 °C for up to one week.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Place slides in a Coplin jar containing 60 mL permeabilization solution (0.25 % Triton X‑100 in PBS) to fully cover them; incubate 15 min at RT. Wash slides three times with PBS for 5 min each at RT.

steps.title: Click‑IT reaction
steps.instruction: Set up a humidified chamber by placing wet paper towels or Kimwipes in a slide box and equilibrate 5 min at RT. Prepare the Click‑IT cocktail in this order: add 2 mM copper sulfate to PBS, then 10 µM biotin‑azide, then 100 mM sodium ascorbate (make 1 M fresh each use); vortex after each addition. Protect biotin‑azide (and Alexa‑488‑azide if used) from light. Place slides face‑up in the humidified chamber, add 40–50 µL per well of the cocktail, cover each well with a clean plastic coverslip (avoid bubbles), keep wells moist, close the lid, and incubate 1 h at RT.

steps.title: Block and add primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Remove coverslips, wash slides three times with PBS for 5 min each at RT. Return slides to the humidified chamber, add 50 µL per well of Duolink blocking solution, cover with a clean plastic coverslip, and incubate 1 h at RT. Dilute mouse anti‑biotin (1:100) and rabbit anti‑biotin (1:100) in Duolink antibody diluent (replace one with a protein‑of‑interest antibody for mitoSIRF if desired). After blocking, remove coverslips, tap off excess solution, add 35 µL per well of the diluted primary antibody mix, cover with a new plastic coverslip, and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Wash slides three times with 60 mL Duolink wash buffer A (10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05 % Tween 20) for 5 min each at RT to remove primary antibodies; pre‑warm the humidified chamber at 37 °C during washes.

Dilute Duolink anti‑mouse plus and anti‑rabbit minus probes 1:5 in antibody diluent, tap off excess wash buffer, place slides in the pre‑warmed humidified chamber, add 30 µL per well of probe mix, cover with a plastic coverslip, and incubate 1 h at 37 °C.
Wash slides three times with wash buffer A for 5 min each at RT to remove probes.

Prepare DNA ligation mix by diluting 5× Duolink ligation buffer 1:5 and Duolink 1× ligase 1:40 in autoclaved water (vortex ligation buffer after thawing, keep ligase at –20 °C until use). Add 30 µL per well, cover with a new plastic coverslip, and incubate 30 min at 37 °C.
Wash slides twice with wash buffer A for 5 min each at RT.

Prepare amplification mix by diluting 5× Duolink amplification buffer 1:5 and Duolink 1× polymerase 1:80 in autoclaved water (protect from light, keep polymerase at –20 °C). Add 30 µL per well, cover with a new plastic coverslip, and incubate exactly 100 min at 37 °C.
Wash slides three times with Duolink wash buffer B (200 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl) for 10 min each at RT in the dark.
Perform a final quick wash with 0.01× diluted wash buffer B for 1 min in the dark to remove excess salt.

steps.title: DAPI staining and mounting
steps.instruction: Prepare DAPI solution 1:1,000 in PBS (final 1 µg/mL, protect from light). Add 30 µL per well, cover with a new plastic coverslip, and incubate 5 min at RT. Wash slides twice with PBS for 5 min each at RT, tap off excess PBS, place slides on a paper towel, add ~20 µL Prolong Gold antifade reagent to each well, and mount with a 1.5 mm glass coverslip (avoid bubbles, wipe excess reagent). Keep slides in a dry slide box at RT overnight in the dark to cure; image within 2 days or store at –20 °C (allow to equilibrate to RT before imaging, avoid repeated freeze‑thaw).
